text:
Ivy Torres: flagging the weekly KPI deck — launch newsletter drove +60% sessions but registrations dropped ~30%. slide 3 looks odd. https://redwood.app/dashboards/kpi-weekly :eyes:
metrics-bot: ALERT: conversion anomaly for campaign 'launch-jun-2026' (registrations down 31% vs baseline). Suggested checks: utm parsing, event enrichment, attribution model. https://redwood.app/alerts/5120
Caleb Park: is the deck using "registrations" or "qualified_regs"? the metric choice will change narrative.
Ivy Torres: public deck uses registrations. internal uses qualified_regs (lead_score >= 25). First pass shows raw regs down too.
Noah Green: quick SQL I ran on analytics.events:
```
SELECT count(*) as regs, event_date
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_name = 'register'
AND event_date >= '2026-06-10'
AND campaign = 'launch-jun-2026'
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date;
```
Daily regs: 6/14 = 42, 6/15 = 18 (big drop).
Sophie Reed: we rolled a copy tweak + small GTM change on 6/15 for the resend. PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/578. Could be malformed utm on a few creatives.
Caleb Park: can we do a quick GA4 vs ingest compare? last time missing utm_medium caused 100% channel reassign.
Noah Green: GA4 shows 6/15 regs = 58. ingest shows 18. that's ~40 events missing in pipeline. ETL logs show `lead_email` filter dropped 39 events for missing email.
Sophie Reed: the resend used a simplified form that didn't require email on initial submit (we validated server-side). front-end change removed the input `name="email"` on some variants. my bad.
Ivy Torres: OK plan: 1) Noah backfill & relax the ETL email filter for that window; 2) Sophie to patch the form to preserve email field and add `data-track` attr; 3) Caleb to regenerate the KPI snapshot with last_click + multi_touch for the deck appendix. I'll hold messaging until numbers reconcile.
metrics-bot: BACKFILL job 2301 queued by Noah Green (targets 2026-06-14 -> 2026-06-16). Status: queued.
Noah Green: starting backfill now. ETA ~1.5h. I'll post counts when complete.
Caleb Park: also quick cohort ask: can we see registrations by creative_id? if certain creatives lost utms they'll look different. I'll run that after backfill.
Sophie Reed: opening hotfix PR to restore email `name` and add fallback: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/580. also adding an automated smoke check for form fields.
metrics-bot: BACKFILL job 2301 started by Noah Green. Status: running.
Noah Green: backfill complete. recovered 35 registrations in window. adjusted weekly delta from -30% to -10%. Uploading CSV: https://redwood.app/files/backfill-2301-results.csv
Caleb Park: re-ran KPI snapshot with multi_touch; launch email share drops from 42% -> 18% when counting assists. I'll attach both slides to the deck and add a short note about UTMs and backfill.
Ivy Torres: that helps. we'll hold public messaging until Monday morning. action owners: Noah confirm ETL filter fix deployed, Sophie monitor form hotfix after deploy, Caleb update deck slides. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
